variant: XC820.1 (1.5 m horizontal, 4.0 m vertical reach)
name: Befard XC820.1 glazing robot
summary: Battery electro-hydraulic wheeled glazing robot with eight vacuum cups that lifts glass, windows and panels of up to 820 kg to about 4.0 m and sets them into openings by radio remote control. Made by Befard in Poland; the shortest-reach version of the XC820.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Polish maker Befard (German-language product page with contact form). Befard names GreenLifter in Fürth as its German sales partner. Only the XC820.3 was found with a price (Maschinensucher.de, €34,900 plus VAT); no price was found for the XC820.1.

sellers.name: Befard
sellers.note: Ul. Pod Grapą 4, 43-340 Kozy, Poland. Contact form, phone and WhatsApp on the product page.

sellers.name: GreenLifter
sellers.note: Boxdorfer Str. 35, 90765 Fürth. Named by Befard as its German sales partner ("Niemcy - GreenLifter"); this model is not shown on a GreenLifter page.

specs.label: Vacuum cups
specs.conditions: 100 mm side shift, variable cup spacing
specs.quote: Akku-/elektrohydraulischer Montageroboter für Glas/Fenster/Flächen (Innen/Außen) mit 100 mm Seitenverschub und variablen Sauger Abständen.

notes: Arm = hydraulic telescopic boom with a vacuum cup beam; options include hydraulic side shift and beam rotation (each reduces the load by 100 kg), hook and forks.
Battery electro-hydraulic machine, steered by an operator with the Befard radio remote control; not autonomous.
Indoor and outdoor use per maker ("Innen/Außen"); outriggers extend to 1,800 mm.
Drive type, speed and runtime are not stated on the pages read.
